extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners; individuals seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; Office of Enrollment and Discipline stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: A decision document addressing a petition for reinstatement of a former registered practitioner under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58, summarizing the materials considered and the Director's determination to grant reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Sandon M. Duncan (Registration Number 64,141) received on December 15, 2022. Mr. Duncan has filed an affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After careful review of the petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
